description: This file defines the PHP class Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Nil which represents an XML-RPC 'nil' value in the Zend Framework's XML-RPC Value package.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Nil
classes.description: A class representing an XML-RPC nil value that extends Zend_XmlRpc_Value_Scalar.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object, setting the type to XMLRPC_TYPE_NIL and value to null.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns null, representing the XML-RPC nil value as a PHP null.
